about: Demos page, Goten (brief v3 §5, §6). Rows are line indexes into site-src/demos-goten.json; cols pick table cells; narrowHide drops cells below 900px. Copy: each sentence is [text, covers]. Built by scripts/build-demos.mjs, checked by check-site.

needs.title: Set up the deal and bring in your lists
needs.path: [[Load sample deal]], then [[Deal settings]]. For an import, open [[Import investors (replaces the list)]] on [[1. Reconciliation]].

scenes.title: Set the deal up once
copy: The as-of date decides which receipts count: anything dated later is not counted.
A2
Currency, the minimum commitment, how investor fees are taken and your initials for each log entry are set once here and used in the steps that follow.
A3 A4 A6
scenes.alt: Deal settings for the sample deal: name, currency GBP, as-of date 2026-10-16, minimum commitment 1000.00.

scenes.title: One bad cell, nothing imported
copy: An unreadable amount refuses the whole file; the error names its row and column.
Paste or choose a CSV file; statements replace or append, and other currencies are refused.
B1 B2 B4
Re-importing investors says first what it would undo; up to 500 investors and 2,000 bank lines.
B5 B6
scenes.alt: An investor import refused: Nothing was imported, because the cash_due in row 2, 1,23, is not an amount.

sources.quote: up to 500 investors, 2,000 bank lines and 500 holdings per deal

needs.title: Match every receipt to an investor
needs.path: [[Load sample deal]], then [[1. Reconciliation]]. Confirm the three suggestions and mark the other two lines [[Not part of this deal]] to reach the last scene.

scenes.title: Nine receipts book themselves
copy: Nine receipts were booked because each bank reference contains exactly one investor's payment reference.
C1
The other £48,840.00 waits for you.
scenes.alt: Reconciliation summary: £114,840.00 of receipts in scope, £66,000.00 booked to investors, £48,840.00 not booked, 3 waiting for review, £124,000.00 cash due.

sources.quote: contains exactly one investor's payment reference

scenes.title: A longer reference is not a match
copy: NW-0019 looks like NW-001, but it is a different reference, so it is never booked to Amelia Hart.
C2
A receipt unmatched for longer than your setting gets a reminder; it is not a deadline.
C5 A5
scenes.alt: Bank lines: A HART and B OKAFOR matched automatically; WESTBRIDGE SUPPLIES not matched, flagged as unmatched for 13 days; SAM PATEL with reference NW-0019 not matched.

scenes.title: A near-match still waits for you
copy: Kavya Iyer's £7,500.00 came in as NW 11: 0.25 for a near reference, 0.30 for the name, 0.25 for the amount.
C3
Nothing is booked until you confirm it.
Copy query asks about the date and amount only — never the payer, reference or transaction ID.
C9
scenes.alt: A receipt waiting for review: £7,500.00 from K IYER with reference NW 11, suggested for Kavya Iyer with score 0.80 because the reference nearly matches and the payer name and amount match.

sources.quote: 0.25 for a near reference, 0.30 for the payer name and 0.25 for the amount

scenes.title: Every bank line says how it was decided
copy: After the review each line has a status, and Undo takes a decision back.
C4
Editing a line or an investor sets earlier decisions aside, and a possible duplicate import is never booked on its own.
C6 C5
scenes.alt: Bank lines after the review: matched automatically, confirmed by you, not part of this deal, skipped as not a receipt, and after the as-of date so not counted.

needs.title: Chase who has not paid
needs.path: As above, then [[Copy message]] next to David Kim.

scenes.title: The chase email, ready to send
copy: Copy message puts a chase email for David Kim, £500.00 short, on your clipboard to send yourself.
C8
If the browser blocks it, the text is shown to copy by hand.
C8
Export chase list CSV gives everyone short or unpaid in one file.
C8
scenes.alt: Investor payment status: Chloe Martin paid in full; David Kim underpaid by £500.00, with his chase message copied; Hugo Bernard overpaid by £5,000.00; James Whitfield not paid.

sources.quote: gives everyone on the chase list in one file

needs.title: Handle changes before closing
needs.path: [[Take the tour]], click [[Allocation]] at the top of the tour card, then [[Exit tour]]. [[Mark withdrawn]] is on [[1. Reconciliation]]. For the fee change, take the tour again, set [[Minimum commitment]] to 970 in [[Deal settings]], then pick a [[New payer]] under [[Change who pays a fee]] on [[2. Allocation]].

scenes.title: A withdrawal moves money to refunds
copy: With written consent, Lucas Meyer is marked withdrawn: his £3,000.00 is listed to refund and he is no longer chased.
D1
Undo withdrawal reverses it.
scenes.alt: Reconciliation summary after a withdrawal: cash due excluding withdrawn £121,000.00, and Withdrawn: 1 investor, £3,000.00 to refund.

scenes.title: Move a fee, keep every investment
copy: Moving the 3% platform fee to the company keeps each investment and lowers cash due by £3,720.00; whoever paid the old amount is listed for a refund.
D2
It needs consent, can be reversed, and locks the currency; later edits void it or prompt a re-check.
D2
scenes.alt: Change who pays a fee: the platform fee moves from investors to the company; Amelia Hart's cash due falls from £10,000.00 to £9,700.00 with the same investment; the button reads Apply: 0 top-ups totalling £0.00, 12 refunds totalling £3,720.00.

needs.title: Close the round
needs.path: [[Take the tour]], click [[Allocation]] at the top of the tour card, then [[Exit tour]]. For the blocker, set [[Round cap]] to 80000.

scenes.title: Know the wire before you close
copy: The company pays Legal & admin out of the wire, so £98,895.00 goes to the company.
E3
The round has a £2.4137 share price and a £150,000 cap.
E1
The hand-off is a snapshot: change reconciliation later and this page says it is out of date.
scenes.alt: Allocation result: cash received £103,500.00, total invested £100,395.00, investor fees £3,105.00, refunds £0.00, company-paid fees £1,500.00, wire to company £98,895.00.

scenes.title: Every fee has a payer
copy: Investors, the company or the lead can pay a fee, as a percentage or a fixed amount.
E2
Company fees come off the wire; the lead's are invoiced and do not reduce it.
E2
scenes.alt: Fees: Platform fee paid by investors, percentage, 3; Legal & admin paid by the company, fixed total, 1500.00.

scenes.title: Whole shares for S/EIS
copy: Investors hold fractions through the nominee, but relief is per whole share: £1.76 of Amelia Hart's investment is not claimable.
E6 A7
Goten estimates; it does not judge eligibility.
scenes.alt: Allocation per investor: Amelia Hart invests £9,700.00 for 4018.726436 shares, of which 4,018 shares or £9,698.24 are S/EIS claimable and £1.76 is not; James Whitfield is out, no money received.

scenes.title: A blocker names who is affected
copy: With a £80,000 cap everyone is scaled back, Isla Campbell falls below the £1,000 minimum, and the deal cannot close.
E5
Copy and export wait until it is resolved.
scenes.alt: Can't close yet: after scale-back, Isla Campbell falls below the minimum commitment.

sources.quote: a cap of £80,000 scales everyone back and stops the close, because Isla Campbell falls below the £1,000 minimum

scenes.title: A summary the lead confirms
copy: Copy closing confirmation gives the lead totals, fees and each investor; Hugo Bernard's over-payment is listed separately.
E7
If an investor with a listed refund is edited by hand after the hand-off, you choose Keep refund or Remove refund first.
E4
Then Hand off to exit distribution.
E8
scenes.alt: The closing confirmation for the lead: totals, fees, the wire to the company of £98,895.00, each investor, and over-payments to refund, Hugo Bernard £5,000.00.

needs.title: Split the exit, step by step
needs.path: [[Take the tour]], click [[Exit]] at the top of the tour card, then [[Exit tour]]. Choose [[Tiered by return multiple]] under [[Carry]], or set [[Exit proceeds]] to 80000 for the loss.

scenes.title: Carry is exactly 20% of the profit
copy: A £390,000 exit after 6 years with £4,500 of costs: investors get their money and an 8% hurdle first, then the lead catches up.
F1
The lead's £57,021.00 is 20% of the £285,105.00 profit; Export holdings CSV and Export distribution CSV save the figures.
F2 F6
scenes.alt: The exit waterfall step by step: exit costs, return of capital £100,395.00, preferred return £58,919.25, lead catch-up £14,729.81, carried interest split; in total £328,479.00 to investors and £57,021.00 to the lead.

sources.quote: £390,000 of proceeds, £4,500 of costs, 6 years held, 20% carry, an 8% hurdle
Carry comes to exactly 20% of the £285,105.00 profit.

scenes.title: Or carry in tiers by return multiple
copy: Tiered carry has no hurdle or catch-up: each rate applies only to the profit inside its band.
F3
The last band has no ceiling, and Add tier adds a band above it.
scenes.alt: Carry set to tiered by return multiple: one tier, up to multiple no ceiling, and an empty carry rate.

scenes.title: A loss is not an error
copy: With £80,000 of proceeds investors share £75,500.00, 0.75x, and there is no carry.
F5
If costs are more than the proceeds, Goten shows the shortfall and distributes nothing.
F5
scenes.alt: Distribution per investor when the exit makes a loss: Amelia Hart invested £9,700.00 and receives £7,294.69, a multiple of 0.75x.

sources.quote: With £80,000 of proceeds in the sample, investors get £75,500.00 between them, 0.75x.

needs.title: Trust the figures, keep the record
needs.path: [[Load sample deal]], confirm the three suggestions, mark the other two lines [[Not part of this deal]], [[Hand off to allocation]], then open [[Activity log]].

scenes.title: Every result checks itself
copy: A failed self-check hides the figures, a blocker holds export and hand-off, needs-review waits for you, and a reminder stops nothing.
G1
Money is whole pence, and v1.5.0 passed 551 unit tests and 272 of 272 due test-plan cases.
G2 G3
scenes.alt: Allocation checks, all passing: for every investor, cash received equals invested plus platform fee share plus fees plus refund; no refund is negative; the wire plus company-paid fees equals total invested; at least one investor is in; nobody falls below the minimum.

sources.quote: 551 unit tests, 272 of 272 due test-plan cases

scenes.title: Every decision, on the record
copy: Investor and bank imports, decisions, hand-offs, copied messages, withdrawals and fee changes are logged, newest first.
G4
The ledger, chase list, allocation, distribution and log export as CSV; the deal stays in this browser.
G5 G6
If the browser cannot save, the page says so.
G7
scenes.alt: The activity log, newest first: the hand-off to allocation, a line marked not part of this deal, Kavya Iyer's receipt confirmed, and the sample loaded.

needs.title: Learn it on the sample
needs.path: On first open, choose [[I understand — take the 3-minute tour]]; later, [[Take the tour]] in the sidebar. [[Load sample deal]] brings the sample back, [[Clear all data]] empties the page, and [[Send feedback]] is in the footer.

scenes.title: A 3-minute tour on the sample
copy: Twelve steps walk the sample from receipts to exit; Do this for me can act for you.
H1
Key terms have a ? explanation.
H4
Choose System, Light or Dark; printing is always black on white.
H5
scenes.alt: The guided tour at step 4 of 12: Typo, NW 11 instead of NW-011; the score is high, 0.80, but it is still your decision. Confirm Kavya.

sources.quote: walks the same deal in 12 steps
